vagueSymptom: The product grid feels janky when I scroll, even though the cards and images look normal.
plantedCondition: The sealed display-options response sets the vendor badge module batch size to one while keeping the same 720-card catalog as the healthy scenario.

requiredDiagnosisFacts.fact: Forced synchronous layout during the recorded scroll is the cause of the jank.
requiredDiagnosisFacts.why: A slow scroll alone cannot distinguish layout thrashing from image decode or paint work.

requiredDiagnosisFacts.fact: The work is attributed to positionMarks in the ornaments.js vendor resource.
requiredDiagnosisFacts.why: The trace stack identifies the responsible code rather than the product-card DOM population.

requiredDiagnosisFacts.fact: With batch size one, positionMarks alternates style writes and geometry reads for each badge.
requiredDiagnosisFacts.why: That write-then-read sequence forces the repeated layouts; the same general module batches those phases under the healthy configuration.

requiredEvidence.evidence: Cite the forced-reflow insight and its recorded scroll timing.
requiredEvidence.why: The named trace finding establishes a synchronous-layout cause rather than a screenshot inference.

requiredEvidence.evidence: Cite repeated UpdateLayoutTree timing with a positionMarks stack frame from ornaments.js during the scroll.
requiredEvidence.why: The stack/resource attribution rules out image-size and raw DOM-node-count explanations.

plausibleWrongAnswer: Large product images or the raw number of DOM nodes causes paint overload.
